data.raw_text:
[4:39PM] #MobolajiBankAnthonyWay #TrafficUpdate 

 Along the service lane of Anthony, the journey towards Maryland intersection experiences slow but steady movement, continuing smoothly through Odo Iyalaro. Mobolaji Bank Anthony Way heading inward Custom is clear; however, traffic becomes congested from Custom towards Ikeja proper due to commercial activity on Awolowo Road, Ikeja. Our personnel are present to manage the flow.

Moving towards Kodesoh, the inward journey underneath the bridge is experiencing heavy traffic due to ongoing commercial activities. Conversely, the return journey from Kodesoh towards the LASUTH underpass is currently clear. Oba Akinjobi Ikeja inward towards Police College is flowing freely, but the return journey from Police College towards Kodesoh is busy. 

Mobolaji Bank Anthony Way heading inward towards Maryland is currently clear.
Both the Oba Akran link bridge and the Airport link are reporting good traffic flow at this time. Officers are stationed at various potential congestion points to facilitate movement. No impediments to traffic flow are observed at present. 

#FollowLASTMA

[4:48PM] #AjasaCommand #TrafficUpdate 

 The Megida Ayobo axis extending through Amule and Oluwaga down to the Church roundabout is experiencing smooth traffic conditions at the time of this report. Specifically, the areas of Adefemi, Oju, and the Church roundabout are moving without issue.

 However, the vicinity of Command Secondary School is encountering slower traffic due to commercial activities in the area. Furthermore, the Ekoro junction is experiencing slow movement. Our officers are present at this location to manage the flow and mitigate any potential congestion.

#FollowLASTMA

data.raw_text:
[4:52PM] #Ejigbo #Ikotun  #TrafficUpdate 

Vehicular movement from Ikotun Roundabout through Old Garage outwards is currently smooth. However, the return journey on this route is experiencing slower traffic due to commercial activities concentrated at Ikotun Roundabout.
Similarly, traffic along the route from Ikotun Roundabout through Oju Odo, in both inward and outward directions, is moving slowly due to the activities of commercial buses in the area. LASTMA officers are present to manage the traffic flow.

The route from Synagogue, heading towards Ilewe, Cele Egbe, Power Line, Iyana Ejigbo, NNPC Junction, Mobostic, and inwards Canoe, is currently clear with good traffic flow.
At Jakande Roundabout, outward traffic is a little busy due to commercial activities. Our men are on ground managing traffic in this area.

The return journey from Jakande Roundabout inwards NNPC Junction, down to Iyana Ejigbo, Power Line, Ilewe, and finally to Oju Odo and Ikotun, is currently experiencing good traffic flow with no reported impediments.

#FollowLASTMA
